description:
File:crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs:9
Decision: SetError, SetErrorType, and BackendSetError were moved from jmap-chat-server to jmap-server (the protocol-layer crate), re-exported through jmap-chat-server for backwards compatibility.
Why good: These types are defined by RFC 8620 §5.3, which applies to every JMAP object type, not just Chat. Placing them in the protocol-layer crate (jmap-server) means jmap-mail-server, future jmap-calendar-server, etc. all share one canonical definition with no duplication. Keeping them in a domain-specific crate would have forced every other server crate to either copy the definition or take an unnatural dependency on jmap-chat-server.
title: GOOD: SetError/SetErrorType base type in jmap-server not jmap-chat-server
